next_issue.title: feat(draw): automated floating viewports and 3-tier dimensioning on floor plans
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement automated architectural dimensioning and model-to-paper floating viewports centered on building bounds.

### Tasks
1. Calculate model-to-paper viewport transformation with exact standard architectural scales (1:50, 1:75, 1:100).
2. Implement Auto 3-Tier Dimensioning on building perimeter:
   - Tier 1 (Inner): Openings (doors/windows) and wall offsets.
   - Tier 2 (Middle): Grid-to-grid column distances.
   - Tier 3 (Outer): Total building width and length.
3. Place automated Grid bubbles (A, B, C / 1, 2, 3) and room centroid level tags (`FL.1 +0.00`).
4. Add unit tests in `tests/test_draw_dimensions.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(draw): architectural Door and Window Elevation Schedules and Hardware Specifications
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Generate standard architectural Door & Window schedules (แบบขยายประตู-หน้าต่าง) with 2D elevations, opening dimensions, and hardware specification tables.

### Tasks
1. **Elevation Vector Rendering:**
   - Render 2D elevation views for each door type (`D1`, `D2`, `D3`) and window type (`W1`, `W2`, `W3`) showing frame, swing direction dashed lines, and glass panes.
2. **Hardware & Material Schedule Table:**
   - Dimensions: clear opening width x height ($W \times H$), sill height.
   - Frame material (e.g. powder-coated aluminum, hardwood).
   - Panel/glazing specification (e.g. 6mm green tinted float glass, solid core wood).
   - Hardware accessories list: stainless steel hinges, lever handle locksets, flush bolts, and door closers.
   - Automated quantity take-off count per type from building manifest.
3. **Layout Integration:**
   - Fit schedule and detail elevations onto standard A3 Paper Space drawing sheet (`A-401`).
4. **Tests:**
   - Add unit tests in `tests/test_draw_door_window_schedule.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(draw): structural RC Beam, Column, and Footing Detail Schedules with rebar arrangement
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Generate standard reinforced concrete structural detail sheets (แบบขยายโครงสร้าง คสล.) showing cross-sections and rebar arrangements for beams, columns, and footings.

### Tasks
1. **Beam Cross-Sections (แบบขยายหน้าตัดคาน):**
   - Cross-section dimensions ($B \times D$, e.g. $0.20 \times 0.40\text{ m}$ for `DB1`).
   - Main rebar callout (e.g. 2-DB12 top, 2-DB12 bottom) and stirrup ties (`RB9@0.15 m`) with clear concrete covering.
2. **Column Sections (แบบขยายหน้าตัดเสา):**
   - Rectangular and circular column sections (e.g. $0.40 \times 0.40\text{ m}$ for `C1`).
   - Longitudinal rebar (e.g. 4-DB16 / 8-DB16) with tie stirrups.
3. **Footing Details (แบบขยายฐานราก):**
   - Spread footings (`F1` $1.00 \times 1.00 \times 0.30\text{ m}$) and pile caps.
   - Bottom reinforcement mat (`DB12@0.15 m` both ways), compacted sand (10cm), and lean concrete (5cm).
4. **Layout Integration:**
   - Auto-arrange structural detail sections into standard A3 structural sheet (`S-201`).
5. **Tests:**
   - Add unit tests in `tests/test_draw_structural_details.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(draw): MEP Electrical Single Line Diagram and Plumbing Sanitation Riser Diagrams
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Generate schematic diagrams for building MEP systems (งานระบบอาคาร): Electrical Single Line Diagram and Sanitation Riser Diagram.

### Tasks
1. **Electrical Single Line Diagram (ไดอะแกรมไฟฟ้า):**
   - Power meter / incoming supply $\rightarrow$ Main Distribution Board (MDB) / Consumer Unit.
   - Main breaker rating, sub-breakers, and branch circuit schedule (lighting, receptacles, air-con, water heater).
2. **Sanitation & Plumbing Riser Diagram (ไดอะแกรมสุขาภิบาล):**
   - Cold water supply riser: Main meter $\rightarrow$ underground/ground water tank $\rightarrow$ booster pump $\rightarrow$ fixture branch feeds.
   - Soil, waste, and vent pipe schematic: Soil/waste fixtures $\rightarrow$ vertical stacks $\rightarrow$ Septic Tank $\rightarrow$ grease trap $\rightarrow$ public storm drain.
3. **Layout Integration:**
   - Place diagrams neatly onto standard A3 MEP drawing sheet (`EE-101`, `SN-101`).
4. **Tests:**
   - Add unit tests in `tests/test_draw_mep_diagrams.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(draw): automated Drawing Sheet Index generator for multi-discipline drawing sets (A, S, EE, SN)
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Implement an automated Drawing Index / Sheet List generator (ตัวสร้างสารบัญแบบอัตโนมัติ) across all disciplines to eliminate manual table typing and out-of-sync sheet lists.

### Tasks
1. **Sheet Discovery & Aggregation:**
   - Discover all generated sheets across Architectural (`A-xxx`), Structural (`S-xxx`), Electrical (`EE-xxx`), and Sanitation (`SN-xxx`).
   - Compile tabular index columns: Sheet Number (`เลขที่แบบ`), Sheet Title (`ชื่อแบบ`), Scale (`มาตราส่วน`), Revision (`ครั้งที่แก้ไข`), Remarks (`หมายเหตุ`).
2. **Cover & Index Sheets Generation:**
   - Generate discipline-specific index sheets: `A-001` (Architectural Index), `S-001` (Structural Index), `EE-001` (Electrical Index), `SN-001` (Sanitation Index).
   - Support Master Index sheet `G-001` (สารบัญแบบรวมทั้งโครงการ) with total sheet count summary (e.g. "รวมแบบทั้งชุด 48 แผ่น").
3. **Dynamic Auto-Sync:**
   - When any floor, detail, or sheet is added, renamed, or renumbered, re-running `debim draw` instantly regenerates all index tables with zero manual retyping.
4. **Tests:**
   - Add unit tests in `tests/test_draw_sheet_index.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(draw): reusable DXF blocks and standard CAD layer segregation (A-WALL, S-COLS, A-DOOR, S-BEAM)
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Organize 2D drafting entities into reusable DXF Blocks (`BLOCK` & `INSERT`) with strict AIA/ISO layer conventions.

### Tasks
1. Generate reusable 2D blocks for doors (`D1`, `D2`), windows (`W1`, `W2`), sanitary fixtures, column sections (`C1`), and grid bubbles.
2. Assign entities to standard layers with distinct colors and line weights (`A-WALL`, `S-COLS`, `S-BEAM`, `A-DOOR`, `A-GLAZ`, `DIM-ANNO`, `GRID-ANNO`).
3. Ensure DXF output opens cleanly in CadCraft and AutoCAD with full `BLOCK` hierarchy.
4. Add tests in `tests/test_draw_dxf_blocks.py`.
next_issue.label: jules

next_issue.title: feat(cli): add debim draw --layout --batch-pdf command for multi-sheet blueprint plotting
next_issue.body:
### Overview
Add CLI command `debim draw` supporting automated multi-sheet batch plotting to PDF.

### Tasks
1. Add `debim draw` CLI subcommand with options:
   - `--layout <A3|A2|A1>`
   - `--scale <1:100|1:50>`
   - `--batch-pdf <output.pdf>`: Consolidated multi-page PDF containing Cover & Sheet Index, all floor plans, roof plan, structural beam layouts, elevations, door/window schedules, RC details, and MEP diagrams.
2. Ensure changing project/engineer metadata in manifest regenerates all 100+ sheets with one command.
3. Provide clean vector output ready for PdfCraft digital signatures and stamping.
4. Add CLI end-to-end tests in `tests/test_cli_draw.py`.
next_issue.label: jules
